title: Biden Is Not Joking Around
summary:
The potential implications of an unprecedented SPR release
President Biden is determined to bring down oil and gasoline prices and yesterday he announced that the U.S. will release up to 180 million barrels of oil from the government's Strategic Petroleum Reserve (SPR) over the next six months, starting in May. SPR is the world's largest emergency supply of crude oil.
